read_type.help_text: Platform the data you wish to receive was sequenced on Illumina|ont

ont_get_read_type.help_text:
[ONT reads only] Retrieves the read files based on the selected option [reads|unbasecalled].
            If 'reads' is selected, Beefeater will select the reads files according to this priority rule: 'fastq' > 'pass fastq' > 'pass bam' > 'unbasecalled' ("squiggles", in either pod5 or fast5 format).

service_user.help_text: Skip beefeater's iRODS login check (iexpire). For service users, which authenticate to iRODS another way.

irods_batch_count.help_text: Maximum number of beefeater jobs the files are split between. More batches start unpacking sooner but submit more jobs therefore more files.

irods_min_batch_size.help_text: Minimum number of files per beefeater job; runs with too few files for irods_batch_count batches of this size use fewer batches.

irods_ont_batch_size.help_text: Number of ONT collections downloaded per beefeater job; collections can be very large and are downloaded asynchronously.

irods_max_concurrent_gets.help_text: Maximum number of beefeater download jobs running at once.

irods_pool_size.help_text: iRODS connections held open by each beefeater download job. iRODS asks each user to keep to 10-15 connections in total (irods_max_concurrent_gets x irods_pool_size).

irods_search_pool_size.help_text: iRODS connections held open by the beefeater search job. The search finishes before any download starts, so it does not add to the download connections.

irods_search_tokens.help_text: LSF seqirods tokens requested by the beefeater search job.

irods_get_tokens.help_text: LSF seqirods tokens requested by each beefeater download job. The cluster has 1000 tokens shared by all users.

cleanup_intermediate_files_irods_extract.help_text: Delete intermediate CRAM files downloaded from IRODS in work/ folder

raw_reads_suffix.help_text: Suffix to the output fastq file basename for raw downloaded reads, as opposed to the preprocessed reads.

raw_reads_output_dir.help_text: Output directory for raw downloaded reads, as opposed to the preprocessed reads.

save_method.help_text: Save output files in per sample folders (nested) or in one folder (flat)

large_data.help_text: If the data is very large instead start from the week queue with more memory (10GB)

save_metadata.help_text: If true, save all lane/sample metadata into a CSV file named 'metadata_irods_queried_<datetime>.csv'. This does not change how FASTQ files are created.

short_metacsv_name.help_text: Use a short date instead of a full timestamp in metadata filenames.
